locations.title: Armory Terminal
locations.description:
**Knowledge Evaluation quiz answers:**
- What was the age of Sovereign Varick on the day of his passing?
  - 115 Years Old (source: [Classified History of the Protectorate](#loc=511555))
- In what ways were the original Articles of Confederation flawed?
  - They naively allowed subjects too much autonomy. Citizens need rules to thrive. (source: [Annotated Map of Arcadias First Colonies](#loc=511554))
- What security measure present on the Flagship of the Sovereign prevents unauthorized deck access?
  - Users must present a desk-specific set of credentials to access any deck of the ship. (source: [Sentinel Correspondence](#loc=495553))
- Who's in charge of the Protectorate's religious development?
  - The Department of Belief. (source: [Communication Exchange Hub](#loc=495483))
- By what criteria does the Protectorate Acumen Test truly place subjects?
  - By Matriarch-ordained principles, built upon by the Consul's able hand. (source: [Early Copy of the Protectorate Acumen Test](#loc=495537))
